name: Országgyűlés (National Assembly)
notes: 199 seats, 2026-2030 term. Who sits and their party are from the Assembly's own list of active representatives (parlament.hu/aktiv-kepviselok-listaja), read in a browser after its CAPTCHA was solved by a person; the list gives no start date. Fidesz and KDNP sit as one group. The 13 nationality spokespersons have no vote and are not counted. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
